description: Meta Ad Library API: Search LinkedIn ads. Ads of the LinkedIn Ad Library by keyword or advertiser name, with country and date filters, up to 25 per call: advertiser, format, ad text and creatives. Run dates, impressions and targeting are in Get a LinkedIn ad. Price: 5 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call). One of q, advertiser is required.

active_from.description: Ran on or after (YYYY-MM-DD, last 12 months)

active_to.description: Ran on or before (YYYY-MM-DD, last 12 months)

country.description: Two-letter country code where the ads were shown, or `ALL`

limit.description: Ads per page (max 25, one page of the source)

q.description: Keyword or phrase in the ad (required unless `advertiser` is set)

name: ads_linkedin_ads_search
title: Search LinkedIn ads
